positive_cases: exact base archive checksum is reproducible
existing freeze tag resolves to its recorded tag object and target commit
archive-only workflow uses read-only contents permission
root contains no application package or deployment manifest
negative_and_adversarial_cases: application scaffold and architecture ZIP additions are rejected
admin phase completion without evidence is rejected
production, deployment, release, and authority claims are rejected
freeze identity, archive digest, tag target, or workflow permission drift is rejected
private-key and high-confidence credential patterns in reachable Git blobs are rejected
durable_state_faults: NOT_APPLICABLE: this candidate introduces no write path, effect, queue, runtime, or durable state
qualification_non_claim: Green tests and a bounded secret scan are implementation evidence only.
